## Summary

Docs live as loose Markdown files in docs/ and per-package READMEs. Scaffold a static docs site (mdBook or Docusaurus) that organizes them into sections without moving the source files' history.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The site builds locally with one command.
- [ ] Navigation groups pages into Concepts, Guides, Reference and Operations.
